name: logo-carousel
blurb: Logos cycle through columns with staggered spring animations.
description: Displays a set of logo SVGs distributed across columns, each logo swapping every 2 seconds with a blur-in spring transition. Columns stagger their animation start. Pre-built logos include Apple, Vercel, Stripe, TypeScript, and others.
use_when: Showcasing partner or sponsor logos in a dynamic, eye-catching marquee.
avoid_when: Motion-sensitive users—no prefers-reduced-motion guard; continuous animation on high-refresh displays.
a11y: Logos are SVG elements with no alt text or ARIA labels. No keyboard interaction. Motion runs regardless of user preference.
